entities.name: church of San Juan (Alevia)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The church of San Juan is in the village of Alevia, Asturias, Spain. Founded in the late 14th century, the building is currently a Baroque temple with remnants of the original Gothic construction. There is a Gothic nave with side porch and double chapel on the north side.
